fees.title: Fees & Buyer Protection
fees.subtitle: Transparent pricing. No hidden costs. The fairest marketplace in Switzerland.
fees.pure_swaps_desc: Swapping items without any cash component? Zero fees. Always. On every plan.
fees.buyer_protection_desc: Every transaction on SwapMart is covered by our buyer protection program:
fees.secure_escrow_desc: Payments are held securely until both parties confirm the transaction is complete. Funds are never released prematurely.
fees.dispute_resolution_desc: If something goes wrong, our team reviews evidence from both parties and mediates a fair resolution within 48 hours.
fees.money_back_desc: If an item is not as described or never arrives, you get a full refund. No questions asked within the protection window.
fees.step1_desc: Cash, swap, or a combination. The seller reviews it.
fees.step2_desc: Chat unlocks so both parties can coordinate the exchange.
fees.step3_desc: The seller marks the deal as completed. Commission is calculated and invoiced.
fees.step4_desc: Leave a review and build your reputation on the platform.
